core_memory.user_nostalgia: I miss my family and our dog Archie. It's hard to balance school and research with family time. I'm grateful for the memories we make together.
core_memory.user_dog_story: I remember when we got Archie. He was tiny and fluffy, and my heart melted when I saw him. I spent every moment I could with him during my winter break, taking him for short walks and teaching him commands. It's amazing how big he's gotten now. He's definitely not that little fur ball anymore!
core_memory.user_hiking_with_archie: I love going on Saturday morning hikes with my family and Archie. He's always so excited to explore and chase squirrels. It's a great way to appreciate nature and remember to breathe. Moments like these remind me to slow down and enjoy the simple things.

archival_memory.research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since the end of my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It's given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor noticed my ability to bridge technical coding with user experience and suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. I was hesitant at first, but it turned out to be a great decision.

archival_memory.user_video_calls: I love video calling my parents and seeing Archie's reaction. He always recognizes my voice and goes nuts, wagging his tail and whining. It's hilarious and heartwarming at the same time. Archie may not perceive images on screens like humans do, but he definitely knows something's up when he hears my voice.
archival_memory.user_family_influence: I'm lucky to have a supportive family. My dad, a software engineer, introduced me to coding and sparked my interest in CS. My mom, a nurse, is the emotional backbone of our family. She's always there for me, offering pep talks and support. My sister is a ball of energy, always plugged into technology and looking for the next big thing. She might just overshadow me in the tech scene!

archival_memory.user_extended_family: I'm lucky to have a loving extended family. My grandparents live far away, but they're always on my mind. My grandma still teases me about the time I broke her antique vase in middle school. Holiday gatherings are a big deal in my family, and Thanksgiving is a potluck extravaganza. Archie always tries to snag food on the floor, but we're careful about what he can eat.
archival_memory.user_family_influence_on_me: I believe that family shapes who I am today. My parents taught me patience and resilience, which I use when working on tough programming projects. My dad showed me how to stay calm and break down problems, while my mom taught me to be patient and empathetic. My sister pushes me to stay up-to-date with new trends, ensuring I don't fall behind. I often share personal stories, like about Archie or funny moments with my sister, in my scholarship and grad school applications because they are important to me.
archival_memory.user_family_description: My family is supportive, close-knit, and lively. They show me unconditional love through their care for Archie. Even with a busy schedule, I know I'm welcome at home, dog hair and all. It's what keeps me going, no matter how many code lines fail. Home is where I recharge, and Archie's excited leaps into my arms are the best welcome home.
